en.headline: Construction Innovation Expo continues at Convention Centre until Wednesday
en.dek: More than 190 exhibitors show AI, robots and sustainable methods at the triennial event organised by the Construction Industry Council and partners.
body: The Construction Innovation Expo 2026 continues today at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, running through Wednesday.

Organised by the Construction Industry Council, the Development Bureau and the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development’s Science and Technology and Industrialisation Development Centre, the triennial flagship event features more than 190 local, mainland and overseas exhibitors.

Displays focus on artificial intelligence and smart construction, construction productivity and robotics, site safety, and sustainable building. Opening hours on Tuesday are 9am to 7pm; the final day runs 9am to 6pm in Hall 1C-E.
The Construction Industry Council said the expo aims to showcase the latest technologies, create a platform for exchange, and accelerate the industry’s transformation.

zh.headline: 建造創新博覽會於會展中心舉行至周三
zh.dek: 三年一度旗艦活動由建造業議會等主辦，逾190家參展商展示人工智能、機械人及可持續建造技術。
body: 建造創新博覽會2026今日繼續在灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行，展期至周三。
活動由建造業議會、發展局及住房和城鄉建設部科技與產業化發展中心共同主辦，是三年一度的旗艦盛事，吸引逾190家本地、內地及海外參展商。
展品集中於人工智能及智能建造、建造生產力及機械人、工地安全，以及可持續建造等領域。周二開放時間為上午9時至下午7時，最後一日上午9時至下午6時，場地為展覽廳1C-E。
建造業議會表示，博覽會旨在展示最新技術，打造交流平台，並加速業界轉型升級。
